bibl.title: Notes on Papyri from Roman Egypt
bibl.seg: 145.4 B.G.U. I, 76; III, 715; XIII, 2319 P. Alex. 17 P. Berol. Inv. 13358 P. Brooklyn 11 P. Col. Inv. 497 P. Cornell Inv. II, 29a P. Freib. II, 10 P. Grenf. II, 53g P. Lond. II, 294 descr. P. Messeri 32 P. Mich. VI, 420; XXI, 845 P. Sakaon 59 S.P.P. XXII, 22
W. Graham Claytor, Notes on Papyri from Roman Egypt.
Pylon. Editions and Studies of Ancient Texts 2 (2022) §1-48, 2 figg.
bibl.note: 1. Jews in Soknopaiou Nesos? [about P. Messeri 32 and B.G.U. XIII, 2319.] - 2. Jewish sitologoi: B.G.U. III, 715 = C.P.Jud. III, 428 (101/2). - 3. S.P.P. XXII, 22 (Philopator-Theogenous, 142). - 4. The Oikogeneia in S.B. XXIV, 16256 = P. Lond. II, 294 descr. (105). - 5. B.G.U. I, 76 (Soknopaiou Nesos, ca. 150-200). - 6. S.B. VIII, 9906 [= P. Cornell Inv. II, 29a] (193/4) and P. Freib. II, 10 (196). - 7. The notary of P. Sakaon 59 (305) and S.B. XVI, 12289 [= P. Berol. Inv. 13358], col. 2 (309). - 8. The dyke of Psei in the Herakleides meris [in P. Mich. XXI, 845; P. Grenf. II, 53g; P. Mich. VI, 420; P. Brooklyn 11; P. Alex. 17]. - 9. P. Col. Inv. 497 [ed.: Uri Yiftach, Experimenting Security: P.Col. Inv. 497 and the Mortgage Regime in early Second Century Oxyrhynchos, ZPE 219 (2021) pp. 167-182] (Oxyrhynchite / Alexandria, 130).
